title: blosc~
description: `blosc~` provides bandlimited oscillators based on a minimal bandlimited comparator, for generating oscillator signals with reduced bandwidth-related artifacts. Its modes shown here include `pulse`, `pulse2`, `saw`, `syncsaw`, and `comparator`, covering one- and two-sided impulses, sawtooth, hard-synced sawtooth, and square/pulse-wave or PWM applications.
